officialEnglishCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE — CARVING CATEGORY
officialEnglishCatalog.evidence: Season-specific catalog provides the exact 63/85 size rows, dimensions, profile diagram, running base and construction. It identifies a full-metal sandwich, Aspen wood core, IZANAS fiber beneath the core, sintered topsheet, 48-hardness steel edge and progressive triple sidecut. Manufacturer construction specifications are not independent ride-test results.

officialSeasonProduct.evidence: Confirms 26/27 model, full-metal + IZANAS construction, flex return description and compatibility testing with ALLFLEX and VIST/separate plates. Specifically says the 185 received an IZANAS volume and uneven-thickness revision for smoother flex return this season; warns bending/breaking of full-metal boards under excessive flex is not covered by warranty.

officialJapaneseProduct.evidence: Current official 26/27 listing labels Japanese prices as ¥180,000 before tax and ¥198,000 tax-inclusive. The 185-season revision and no-warranty warning are stated on this page as well.

officialTechnology.evidence: Season technology page corroborates full-metal sandwich with 0.4 mm Titanal on top and bottom, IZANAS beneath the core, sintered topsheet, and 48-hardness steel edges.

previousSeason163RideReport.evidence: Single-rider 25/26 163 report; tested 2025-03-01 at Edelweiss on an ordinary groomed run near 0°C. The writer describes quick turn initiation, agility, strong inward drive, late-turn acceleration, and a tendency toward deeper turns; felt less stable/strong than Quadra. It is historical, subjective evidence and does not verify 26/27 production.

previousSeason185RideReport.evidence: Single-rider 25/26 185 report; tested 2025-03-15 at Sugadaira in granular snow over ice at about 2°C. The writer describes quick turning, inward drive, light-for-length feel, a sharp late-turn cut, and manageability for rhythm/technical riding; it is not presented as a race-timing specialist. Historical subjective evidence only; the 26/27 185 construction was revised.

unitsAndMapping.lengthsMm: Overall Length, Effective Edge L., and Contact Length are separate catalog columns and are preserved separately.
unitsAndMapping.sidecutRadiusMm: Three printed radii preserved in catalog order; seed stores the sequence in millimeters as printed.
unitsAndMapping.setbackMm: Catalog magnitude; direction/sign convention is not specified.
unitsAndMapping.camberMm: Catalog camber arch value; rocker is shown as none.
unitsAndMapping.edge: Catalog row states 1.8 mm / 48 RCWL; technology page separately describes steel-edge hardness 48.
unitsAndMapping.fiberglass: Catalog construction diagram shows 1-ply 65/35 above and below the Aspen core; 0.4 mm Titanal top and bottom and IZANAS beneath core are separately retained in product-level construction evidence.

scoringReview.decision: Keep all six scores unchanged and mark them low-confidence estimates. Two reports cover previous-season 163 and 185 samples, but each is one rider/session and the 26/27 185 was revised; they do not provide target-season calibration or a shared numerical scale. The reports qualitatively support quick turn initiation and strong carving drive while noting a difference from the more stable/strong-feeling Quadra. No report directly supports float or park scores. Value remains especially uncertain because the displayed CNY figure is converted Japanese MSRP, not China retail.
scoringReview.confidence: low; historical single-rider sessions only, no 26/27 production-sample comparison

mappingNotes: Both catalog rows were compared with seed sizeSpecs; all currently stored geometry, widths, stance, setback, camber, edge, base and sidewall values match.

The seed has no top-level fiberglass field; added the explicitly cataloged 1-ply 65/35 layup while retaining full metal/Titanal and IZANAS construction in the raw source details and product description.
The current product claims broad performance from superpipe/big kicker to high-speed all-mountain freeride; the one-liner was adjusted to avoid narrowing the product to race-only use.
